input_parameters.coordinate_system: millimetres; X tangential, Y up, Z along cannon rearward

critical_limits: Force, mass, centre of mass, pull travel and hand point are explicit assumptions; not measured cannon properties
Reaction solver is a planar rigid-body model of barrel loads supported by lower rail attachment points; top rail is not grounded
Minimum-norm force distribution assumes equal translational point-joint stiffness and is not a bound on actual load sharing
Pair-only cases are sensitivity cases, not permission to operate with loose or missing connections
No clamp friction, bolt preload or load sharing among all six clips is credited
Metal shoulder-to-washer stop, printed-stack capture play and nut engagement must be established by the final assembly CAD
Printed material capacity, local notch factors, contact compliance, transient waveform and fatigue are unverified
Stress screens are analyst-selected thresholds, not manufacturer allowables or factors of safety
Normal pressure, axial bearing, shear-out and flange bending are separate idealizations, not a solved complete contact model
Local normal and tangent components use the recovered 5.4923 degree cone inclination, rather than treating world Y/Z as exact surface axes

proof_scope.established: Algebraic force/moment equilibrium and nominal stress demand for stated geometry, supports and loads
not_established: Actual pulse pressure, ring coherence or range
